envelope.tactical_move: initiate formal external pressure on the toll-road commission via sealed demand
envelope.state_change_precondition: no sealed demand for an investigation into the burning has yet reached the commission
envelope.state_change: the sealed letter is placed in the commission clerk's incoming tray
envelope.forces_choice: forces the player to choose between pressing the demand in person at the first session or letting the letter stand alone
envelope.branch_a: appear at the commission chambers to testify in person
envelope.branch_b: remain at a distance and let the sealed demand work without further intervention
envelope.scene_purpose: make the player's demand to the commission an irreversible fact in the world
envelope.forward_pressure: the commission must now respond to the sealed demand

event_slots.precondition: the sealed letter and a messenger capable of delivering it must be present
event_slots.exit_state: the sealed demand for investigation now sits in the commission's possession
